name: Representation Interaction Flow
ascii:
Legend: [D] = data structure, (O) = operation; source symbols are shown inline.

                         REPRESENTATION INTERACTION

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| USER CHOICES AND ACTIVE CONTEXT                                                                          |
|                                                                                                          |
| (O) DiagramSetTreePanel.tsx:DiagramSetTreePanel                                                          |
|     select DiagramSet / Diagram; mark current and starred entries                                        |
|                                                                                                          |
| (O) DiagramLineagePanel.tsx:renderCandidateBatch/renderDiagram                                           |
|     choose ranked candidate batch, candidate, view kind, or its `featuredViewIds` star                   |
|                                                                                                          |
| (O) DiagramLineagePanel.tsx:ComponentLineageSection                                                      |
|     open a captured/generated DiagramComponent on the component Representation surface                  |
|                                                                                                          |
| (O) RepresentationLayersPanel.tsx:RepresentationLayersPanel                                              |
|     choose revision-bound layer by increasing `informationRank`; submit transition feedback             |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
                                              |
                                              | activates Diagram, component Representation, or layer
                                              v
 (O) DiagramView.tsx:DiagramView
      validate ASCII revision/map; choose tree or diagram index and `gridMode`
      |
      v
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ACTIVE REPRESENTATION SURFACE                                                                            |
|                                                                                                          |
| [D] representationIndex.ts:buildRepresentationIndex                                                      |
|     stable revision-scoped tree nodes and visual `elementId` values                                      |
|     reject stale maps; structural/persisted identities; element <-> Evidence resolver                    |
|                                                                                                          |
| (O) AsciiSelectionGrid.tsx:AsciiSelectionGrid                                                             |
|     indexed hover + source location; mapped reveal; collapse subtree; toggle highlight                   |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
                                              |
                                              | every branch consumes stable IDs and current `revision`
                                              |
      +---- rectangle selection
      |          |
      |          v
      |     (O) DiagramView.tsx:completeSelection
      |          normalize drag bounds -> intersect mappings -> Evidence references
      |          |
      |          v
      |     [D] Scoped reference buffer preview
      |          |
      |          v
      |     (O) RefBufferTray.tsx:displayCallGraph
      |          active-Diagram refs -> validate/dedup CodeEntities -> call-graph focus
      |
      +---- component capture / edit mode
      |          |
      |          v
      |     (O) DiagramView.tsx:saveCapture/editMode
      |          released rectangle -> component capture -> completion feedback
      |          stale mappings excluded; incompatible actions disabled; ASCII editor replaces grid
      |          start/exit edit session; captured component returns to component lineage
      |
      +---- layer transition feedback
      |          same indexed revision -> ordered layer panel and transition target
      |
      +---- mapped Evidence activation
                 |
                 v
           (O) App.tsx:revealCodeEntity
                 |
                 | stable mapping ID + Evidence identity + `sourceRangeIndex`
                 v
           [D] Evidence selection
                 |
                 | load authoritative source snippet
                 v
           [D] Corpus content

           REQUIRED GROUNDING: Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus; no direct shortcut.

 (O) panes/navigation.ts:PaneNavigationApi
      activate/focus pane; bounded dedup jump history; delayed delivery; replay previous or clear
 <========== reversible pane movement across all three stages; grounding direction remains fixed ==========>
